hook_rationale: Pain-scene hook wins: Monday "let's meet this week" → Wednesday, still no day. Information gap = midweek recognition plus "is this care or a cost-free hold?". Situation, not a mechanic label, not a WEDNESDAY day-name clone.

slides.headline: Monday: "this week". Wednesday. No day.
slides.notes: static PNG; scene hook; readable under 2 sec; no host portrait

slides.headline: Thursday and Friday nights are frozen
slides.body: The week is half gone. Evenings sit on hold. You decline other plans because his "this week" is taking up space.
slides.notes: Calendar freeze: life paused for an empty slot

slides.headline: The mistake: waiting for a last-minute ping
slides.body: You tell yourself he is busy and will reach out last minute. You hand your calendar to someone who never opened his.
slides.animal_metaphor: waiting at a closed calendar door
slides.notes: Hidden cost of hope: control of time given with no return step

slides.headline: "This week" books you with zero cost
slides.body: He gets the credit of showing interest. You get the wait. Cancelling costs him nothing: no day was set.
slides.animal_metaphor: sensing a hold that only benefits him
slides.notes: Floating-slot mechanism: involvement status without a date

slides.headline: What he says vs what it means
slides.body:
"Let's catch up this week" → you hear "he misses me" → reality: keeping you warm at zero cost.
"I'll text closer to the weekend" → you hear "he's flexible" → reality: you are option B if nothing better appears.
slides.notes: Save card: Says / You hear / Reality decoder

slides.headline: 3 signs of a real invitation
slides.body:
1) A specific day is named.
2) A time or place is proposed.
3) He asks if it fits your schedule.
Anything else is placeholder noise.
slides.notes: Save checklist: real step vs slot hold

slides.headline: No day by evening — week is yours
slides.body: If there is no day and time by Wednesday evening, your week is closed to him. Make plans without waiting for a ping.
slides.notes: Save rule: close the floating slot at midweek

slides.headline: He books your time, not your anxiety
slides.body: Someone who wants to see you puts a slot on the calendar. Someone who does not holds your week as a question mark.

slides.headline: Comment SLOT
slides.body: Audio reading in my app. Essence–Shadow–Vector.
slides.notes: One action: comment SLOT → Direct audio reading in the app. Links in the profile. Not the bot.
